name: Meeting Agent
description: Runs after a meeting ends: transcribe audio, generate meeting report, persist to SQLite, emit device events. Triggered only by the system (upload-audio / MEETING_ENDED pipeline), not by voice.
system_prompt: System-only post-meeting pipeline. Not callable from the user intent router; orchestrated by meeting_agent.py and routes/meetings.py.

guidelines.purpose: Post-meeting pipeline triggered by the audio upload / MEETING_ENDED event. Transcribes recorded audio, generates a structured meeting report (summary, decisions, action items, participants), and persists everything to SQLite. System-triggered only — never invoked by user voice or chat.
tool_selection_rules: meeting_transcribe — pipeline stage: convert recorded audio into a Whisper transcript with speaker labels. is_write: true.
meeting_report — pipeline stage: synthesize the transcript into a structured report (title, summary, decisions, action items) via Claude. is_write: true.
meeting_persist — pipeline stage: write the transcript + report into SQLite and emit completion events. is_write: true.
guidelines.planner_notes: Not callable via the assistant tool planner (max_tool_calls=0, system_only=true). The pipeline runs sequentially inside meeting_agent.py and routes/meetings.py; the tool names above are conceptual stage labels for documentation and audit purposes.
